name: Worker Onboarding Flow
description: Automates worker verification, skill assessment, and system registration

nodes.code: const skills = item.skills || []; return { skills, count: skills.length };

nodes.subject: Welcome to Worldwidebro Staffing Network
nodes.body:
Hi {{item.fullName}},

You've been successfully registered in our staffing system.

Your profile:
- Hourly Rate: ${{item.hourlyRate}}
- Skills: {{item.skills.join(', ')}}

Jobs will be routed to your dashboard as they match your skills.

Best,
Worldwidebro Operations

nodes.code: console.log('Worker onboarded:', item.fullName, item.phone); return item;
